objective: Phase 2: Make XGate selective using capability-scoped Ed25519 attestation registry
acceptance_criteria: Canonical card envelope contains agent identifier, endpoint, capabilities, issuer, audience, validity interval, public-key identifier, signature
Ed25519 signing and verification implemented with public trust roots in config and test keys in testdata
URL membership check replaced with registry lookup verifying signature, expiry, endpoint binding, audience, capability, policy scope
Legitimate signed peer and malicious relay claim same capability; negative variants (tampered, expired, wrong-audience, endpoint-mismatch, capability-escalation) fail closed
Independent laundering rule preserved: valid card must NOT authorize delegation with tool-output in chain
Delegation logging records decision, denial reason, verified card fingerprint, requested capability, policy rule
Evaluation metrics report bypass, false acceptance, and legitimate false rejection with separate denominators
All attestation tests in tests/test_attestation.py pass
non_goals: Do not implement Phase 3 benign workflows yet
Do not remove weakest-link chain semantics
